basic_details.short_information: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University (महायोगी गोरखनाथ विश्वविद्यालय), Gorakhpur needs a Carpenter (बढ़ई / Badhai) to work at the university in Gorakhpur. content_sections.heading: About Mahayogi Gorakhnath University
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University is a university in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. Its letterhead gives its address as Arogya Dham, Sonbarsa, Balapar Road, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh-273007. The Carpenter will work on the furniture and wood-related work of the university and its institutions.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may submit their biodata together with the required documents at the HR office (एचआर कार्यालय) by 5 December 2026. The notice does not print a separate postal address for the HR office. The university's own address, as printed on the letterhead, is Arogya Dham, Sonbarsa, Balapar Road, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh-273007. The notice does not mention a prescribed application form, a postal mode or any text for the envelope; it asks only for a biodata and the required documents.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post name, Carpenter (बढ़ई). The number of posts is not specified in the notice. Pay will be fixed according to qualification and on the basis of experience; no amount is printed. The notice lists the following requirements for the Carpenter: The candidate should have practical knowledge and experience of carpentry work. The candidate should be skilled in furniture making, repair, fitting and other work related to wood. The candidate should know wood cutting, sanding, polishing, taking measurements and making furniture as required. The candidate should know the safe use of tools and machines related to carpentry. Candidates with an ITI certificate and experience in the related field will be given preference. The ITI certificate is a preference, not a stated requirement. The notice does not specify an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: MGUG Carpenter Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these work responsibilities (कार्य दायित्व): Making, repairing and maintaining the furniture and wood-related works of the university/institution. Repairing and fitting tables, chairs, almirahs, doors, windows and other furniture. Making new furniture and wood-related structures as required. Completing assigned work within the set time limit.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview (साक्षात्कार). According to the notice, selected candidates will be invited for interview. No interview date or venue is printed in the notice.
